item.title: Owatonna petitioners hope to force vote on $65M public safety facilities bond
item.description: A grassroots group in Owatonna is advocating for a $65 million public safety project to be put on the ballot. The city has proposed new fire and police stations, with city council members unanimously approving a plan to fund them through homeowner taxes. Concerns have arisen over the cost and the proposed location for the police station on a historic property near City Hall.
